rca of the issue: AuthCallback previously used react-router navigate() which only updates SPA history without unmounting AuthProvider. AuthContext.user therefore stayed null (checkAuth had already skipped due to hash guard, and setLoading(false) left user=null). ProtectedRoute saw user===null and redirected to /login, whose useEffect on AuthContext caused another /auth/me→401 (no cookie yet visible until next request? actually cookie was set — but AuthContext never re-ran checkAuth after the exchange). Fix: window.location.replace('/dashboard') forces a full page reload, re-mounting AuthProvider which calls checkAuth() with the freshly-set httpOnly cookie → /auth/me returns 200 → user populated → ProtectedRoute allows /dashboard. Verified by full-reload simulation with pre-set cookie hitting /dashboard directly.
